in_sanskrit.name: Keethika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of virtue
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Keethika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Keethika is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a feminine name that means 'Goddess of virtue'. In Hindu mythology, Keethika is revered as a symbol of purity, morality, and righteousness.
